sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 4.92% (-8 bp in a month), 2-year 4.63% (-6 bp); 2s10s curve +29 bp (-2 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.17% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 103.87 (+2.0% in a month, +5.7% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.835 (+15.6% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.655 (-0.3%); USD/MXN 19.31 (+3.2%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -5.1% in a month (+5.7% YTD); VIX 29.5. Risk-off: funds tend to cut commodity length along with equities.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 80.71 $/bbl (-20.0% in a month), Brent 87.43, ULSD 3.652 $/gal (-21.9%), natural gas 3.62 (+3.2%). Lower crude weighs on soybean oil and corn through biofuel margins and on cotton via cheaper polyester.

us_econ: Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.73% (+0.85 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.20%, real 10-year 2.78%. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,882 Bcf (week to 2026-11-13), +20 Bcf vs a 5-year average -25 for the week; +98 Bcf (+2.6%) vs the 5-year average, -54 vs last year. Crude stocks 417.8 mb (+3.4 mb on the week, -3.7% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline +5.2 mb, distillate +1.6 mb; refinery utilization 95.7%. 3-2-1 crack $37.82/bbl (ULSD $72.82, gasoline $20.32). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk LOW (1 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -211,476 (2nd pct of 3 yrs, -54,628 in 4 wks)). GEFS AO week 2 -1.19 (now -0.04). No colder forecast trend; trade the fundamentals and the curve. Options: NG IV 84% vs RV 69%; CL IV 45% vs RV 52%; HO IV 50% vs RV 50%; RB IV 44% vs RV 42%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
